title: Guest has a complaint
summary: A guest is unhappy with a recent service. How do you recover the experience?

steps.title: Listen fully
steps.body: Give the guest space to share without interrupting.

steps.title: Acknowledge feelings
steps.body: Apologize sincerely and thank them for the feedback.

steps.title: Clarify needs
steps.body: Ask what would make the experience right for them.

steps.title: Resolve promptly
steps.body: Offer an approved solution and confirm next steps.

steps.title: Follow up
steps.body: Check in after resolution and log the issue for the team.

remember: A recovered moment often creates a stronger relationship.
